notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla publishes the zone identity (leaf -> single-hop parent zone), the ZONE_CHANGED/ZONE_CHANGED_NEW_AREA/ZONE_CHANGED_INDOORS election with the WMO-interior naming override (inn splash), the minimap subzone-else-zone line, and GetZonePVPInfo (friendly/hostile/contested + arena flag). MSUI loads AreaTable.dbc, resolves the terrain-chunk areaId per frame, draws the minimap zone-text line (subzone-else-zone) and sends CMSG_ZONEUPDATE on zone change - but the rest of the family is absent.
